```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(broom)


```

Loading file
```{r}
load(file = "../Outputs/gene.exp")
load(file = "../Outputs/pt.status")
```


```{r}
joined <- left_join(pt.status, gene.exp)
```


```{r}
tc_only <- subset(joined, Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete")
tc_exp <- subset(tc_only, Cohort == "Adj")
tc_val <- subset(tc_only, Cohort == "Adj Validation")

tox_only <- subset(joined, Reason.for.discontinuation == "Toxicity")
tox_exp <- subset(tox_only, Cohort == "Adj")
tox_val <- subset(tox_only, Cohort == "Adj Validation")

rec_only <- subset(joined, Reason.for.discontinuation == "Progression")
rec_exp <- subset(rec_only, Cohort == "Adj")
rec_val <- subset(rec_only, Cohort == "Adj Validation")

cat(tox_val$IFNG, sep = "\n")
```
